lines.name: Nina
lines.en: Morning! Are you here about the weekend job?
lines.zh: 早！你是来应聘周末兼职的吗？

lines.name: 你
lines.en: Yes. The poster said you still require one more helper.
lines.zh: 是的。海报上说你们还需要再招一名帮手。

lines.name: Nina
lines.en: We do. Don't be nervous — the pay is a fair salary plus tips.
lines.zh: 没错。别紧张——工资是固定的薪水，外加小费。

lines.name: 你
lines.en: Sounds great. I really need the money for my books.
lines.zh: 太好了，我买课本正需要这笔钱。

lines.name: Nina
lines.en: Quick test first: can you ___ the change for a 20-dollar bill?
lines.zh: 先考考你：你会计算一张 20 美元该找的零钱吗？

lines.name: 你
lines.en: Of course. I never pretend to know things I can't do.
lines.zh: 当然会。我从不假装会自己做不来的事。

lines.name: Nina
lines.en: Good, honesty matters here. And please never ___ a mistake from me.
lines.zh: 很好，诚实最重要。还有，犯了错千万别瞒着我。

lines.name: 你
lines.en: I promise. If I make a mistake, I'll report it at once.
lines.zh: 我保证。一旦出错，我会立刻报告。

lines.name: Nina
lines.en: One more thing: if a customer shouts at you, don't let it discourage you.
lines.zh: 还有一件事：要是有顾客冲你发火，别灰心。

lines.name: 你
lines.en: I won't. My thick skin will ___ my mother's — she's a nurse.
lines.zh: 不会的。我的抗压能力会像我妈妈一样强——她是护士。

lines.name: Nina
lines.en: Ha! You're hired. Can you start this Saturday? The show for young artists needs staff.
lines.zh: 哈！你被录用了。这周六能来吗？青年艺术家表演需要人手。

lines.name: 你
lines.en: Saturday is fine. If my plans change, I'll cancel three days ahead.
lines.zh: 周六可以。万一计划有变，我会提前三天取消。
